name: Fortify Ribauldequin
description: Fortifies this Ribauldequin, gains 30% range and deploys 5 palings around it. Enemy cavalry that charge into the Palings take 19 damage and are stunned for 2.5 seconds. Range returns to normal and Palings are destroyed when moving away from the position.
descriptionCN: 强化这个机关炮，获得 30% 射程，并在其周围部署 5 个围篱。冲进围篱的敌方骑兵会受到 19 伤害，并会眩晕 2.5 秒。当离开阵地时，射程会恢复正常，围篱被摧毁。
